_comment: EGA Update Console — example configuration (NO real secrets/hostnames). Copy to /etc/ega-update/config.json (0640, root:ega-update) and replace every CHANGEME/placeholder value. Secrets may instead live in environment (EGA_* prefix) or /etc/ega-update/*.secret files (0600). Mirrors every setting in backend/app/config.py.
_comment_secrets_file: secrets_file points at an env-style file (0600); secret values are never inlined in config.json.
_comment_min_free_bytes_removed: min_free_bytes removed: superseded by the 3 GiB disk_floor_bytes floor; if present it is deprecated-ignored.

service_units._comment: Console units (deploy-managed). Managed-tool service units are inventoried per-tool in inventory.json, never here.

adapter_timeouts_s._comment: Per-step ceilings; mirrors backend/app/adapters/base.py ADAPTER_TIMEOUT_DEFAULTS. Hard timeout kills the job cgroup (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after stop_grace_s).
